title: eryngium ebracteatum var. typicum
intro: Eryngium ebracteatum var. typicum, commonly known as the Sea Holly, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the family Apiaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, and its health benefits include its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sea Holly include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Eryngium ebracteatum var. typicum work together to provide a range of health benefits, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
